description: One of a Bot's tasks (baudelib.tasks): a script its host runs, by hand or as a trigger fires, its form filled, its Bot asked when it can't decide or fails.

runtime.description: How its script's run: Python 3, /bin/sh, or given to its Bot as a turn (a prompt).

script.description: Its script (task's answer, and a set's; tasks' listing leaves it out).

version.description: Its script's version: the first 12 hex of its SHA-256.

notify_failure.description: A run that fails is sent to its Bot, with its log.

fallback.description: Notify on failure under its old name, for older heads: read when notify_failure isn't given, and sent as notify_failure is.

notify_exit.description: A run that finishes, exit 0 and not stopped, is told to its Bot, with the end of its output; the Bot isn't asked to act.

timeout_s.description: The longest a run may take; it's stopped after.

paused.description: Its triggers don't fire (it can still be run by hand).

next.description: When a schedule of its fires next.
